title: stale-module-pruner Input Schema
description: Cross-references all files in targetDir with all searchDirs. Any file base name not found inside another file is marked stale.

targetDir.description: Directory to scan for potentially stale files. Default: .claude/lib

searchDirs.description: Directories to search via rg for the file references. Default: [.claude, tests, scripts, package.json]

delete.description: If true, it deletes the file. If false, it simply lists them. Default: false
